registration_status: internal pre-outcome freeze; not an external preregistration
utility_units: Mean directed reference program effect per selected candidate, divided by the fold-specific pooled within-plate input-control cell SD.
inference_scope: conditional measurement intervals, not independent culture/study replication intervals

bootstrap.unit: reference target cells within each drug well; reference vehicle cells within each original vehicle well; same draws shared across programs/methods/directions using those cells
bootstrap.predictions: fixed; no refitting or input-cell uncertainty
bootstrap.biological_scope: conditional measurement intervals, not independent culture/study replication intervals
bootstrap.order: cell line, culture fold, candidate source order, sorted reference plate, sorted reference vehicle well

multiplicity: Two globally aggregated primary utility comparisons use two-sided 97.5% intervals. Subgroups, P@10 and secondary contrasts are descriptive; they are not additional familywise-confirmed hypotheses.
